name: Sinterel
nameOrigin: A working-name compression of sinter, a heat-assisted joining process, and sentinel, reflecting a watchful maintainer that detects and repairs damage; the final species name remains under review.

lore.description: A low six-limbed creature of living metal, the Sinterel climbs Veridium's gantries and draws warm alloy from vents along its body, working it into damaged creatures and structures with a pair of fine tendrils and broad pincers.
appearance: A low broad body made entirely of satin-finished metal
Six jointed load-bearing legs tipped with split gripping pads
A pair of broad facing pincers beneath the front of the body
Two fine tendrils that unfurl from recesses beside the pincers
Narrow vents between the body segments that release bright liquid alloy
A bare unplated surface crossed by slow-moving lines of forge glow
lore.origin: The Veridium Generator produced Sinterels to maintain metal-shaping fauna and factory systems in forge districts where damage accumulates faster than ordinary crews can answer it.
lore.habitat: They move along factory trenches, gantries, salvage fields, and the cooler banks of Veridium's liquid metal channels.
lore.feeding: They draw heat from forge districts and passing metal channels, retaining enough of it to keep a reserve of seam alloy mobile inside the body, and fold small pieces of scrap into that reserve to replace material spent on repairs.
lore.behavior: A Sinterel drums across a damaged surface to map the break, braces it with its pincers, and uses its tendrils to work secreted alloy through the fracture until the joined material bears weight again.
lore.company: Several may converge on widespread damage and coordinate through alternating patterns of seam glow, but they separate once the damaged area is stable.

signatureAbility.name: Ruin Made Whole
signatureAbility.description: The Sinterel floods a wound or fracture with living alloy, then draws the support lattice tight with its tendrils while its pincers hold the damaged body still.
